pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of secondary entries or scaling into losing positions within a 15-minute execution window; pyramiding is only authorized after the primary order has achieved a trailing profit of +$10.00.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero entry authorized during periods where ATR(14) on the 1-minute chart exceeds 3.5x the historical hourly median, and mandatory structural confirmation via order-flow delta imbalance.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop locking at +$4.00 profit to completely eradicate the vulnerability of floating profits evaporating into losses.
